deliveroo.source: Deliveroo_Master_Consolidation.xlsx — Weekly Summary. + ops from Weekly Summary sheet

issues: Covers fell to 1,416 from 1,436 the week before and 1,505 a year earlier.
Spend per head fell to £19.63 from £20.82 the week before and £23.63 a year earlier.
Sales were £41,665.52, up £4,114.15 (10.96%) week on week and down £7,597.21 (15.42%) year on year.
Sales beat the £36,600 target by £5,065.52 (13.84%).
Deliveroo sales were £12,933.10 against £7,369.83 the week before, a record and the top delivery site in the group, which strains prep at peak times.
Monday to Thursday night ramen trade is up on before.
Sushi is taking a hammering because all app offers are ramen focused, with sushi at 17.27% against a 20% target, while drinks and sides remain strong.
Labour was 0.96% under target (20.04% on the BOH meeting sheet), with a FOH and BOH split of 41.83% and 58.17% against a 45% and 55% target.
Food cost was 23.79%, within the 25% budget but the site would prefer it closer to 23%, and Jack finds food cost hard to control while the loyalty promotion runs.
Food usage variance was 2.6%, wet usage variance 3% and total variance 2.6%, and all invoices and orders are accounted for.

Deliveroo lateness is at an acceptable level and prep time is back within target; refund requests rose but were mostly disputed, with three missing items that could not be disputed and only one missing drink found valid.
The site received seven 5 star and two 4 star Google reviews, hitting 100% on the review bonus measure.
The ability to respond to reviews is back, but there is a significant backlog and old responses appear to have gone.
Weekly hygiene compliance scored 100% against a 95% target, and pest control (stabilised and signed off), fire, electrical, gas and ventilation compliance are complete.
The lanterns and taps have been fixed or replaced, and a flickering light above table 102 has a replacement ordered by Kris.
A plumber found the men's bathroom problem is a Scottish Water issue, which Harry is looking into.
A new FOH team member has started full time, and a former team member is looking to return part time from w/c 02/11.
A BOH trial is booked for a candidate who has worked in Manchester, and a BOH full time advert is going up.
With holidays building, Jack is looking for a new chef or kitchen help before Christmas; Penny advised flagging shortages early and noted part time chefs and training as options.
Next week's budget rota is to be finalised by end of day on 07/10 with the following two weeks drafted.
Compliance, Deliveroo accuracy, sushi upselling and review volume are the stated areas for improvement.
The Maki App, XOXO and the lunch menu are the upcoming promotions.

Region-wide (Scotland BOH meeting 06/10): last week's chicken broth usage discrepancy was traced to a takeaway recipe still linked to the old tonkotsu broth in stock counts, which has been corrected, so usage should return to normal next week.

Region-wide (Scotland BOH meeting 06/10): Bidfood is being brought in as a new supplier, starting with Aberdeen and reaching the other sites within one to two months, and new beef samples are being trialled with a view to pre-cooked beef so sites no longer cook it themselves.

Region-wide (Scotland BOH meeting 06/10): frozen ramen promotion stock is delivered from the factory on 07/10, but storage space at the smaller sites is unconfirmed and the memo does not specify quantities per flavour.
